name: AD846 (Analog Devices 450 V/us precision current-feedback op-amp)
tagline: Obsolete ADI current-feedback amp with 12-bit (0.01%) settling. The AD1862 DAC datasheet suggested it for I/V, and diyAudio users still rate it for DAC I/V stages.
technology: Single monolithic bipolar current-feedback (transimpedance) op amp: 450 V/us, 80 MHz (-3 dB, G=-1), 110 ns settling to 0.01%, 200 MOhm open-loop transresistance into 500 Ohm. Obsolete.

part_numbers.notes: Family base number. The ADI product page is under /en/products/obsolete/.

B grade, -40 to +85 C, Q-8 cerdip.

lineage.period: c. 1990 (a SPICE macro-model Rev. A dated 1/91 exists) until obsolescence; exact dates unconfirmed
lineage.notes: Sibling of ADI's AD844/AD811 current-feedback amps. No second source found. ADI pointed users to the AD8001 or AD811 as replacements, according to a diyAudio post.

reputation.summary: On diyAudio, posters call it 'great sounding' and 'very good sounding' for DAC I/V conversion. One thread is titled 'AD 846 AN is there a better sounding opamp out there', and an 'AD 846 replacement' thread began after it went obsolete. ADI's AD1862 datasheet names the NE5534 or AD846 for the current-to-voltage stage. The praise comes from a small niche of forum users, not wide consensus.
typical_uses: DAC current-to-voltage (I/V) converter, e.g. after the AD1862
Output/line stages in DIY DACs and CD-player mods
caveats: Obsolete. Stock sold today is old or of unknown origin.
It is a current-feedback amp, so the feedback resistor sets bandwidth and stability. Forum posters warn that a voltage-feedback op amp may not drop in as a replacement.
A diyAudio poster notes that it was 'only 12 bit accurate' (the datasheet's 0.01% precision claim) and had little commercial success.

revision_history.changes: The final revision, held in ADI's obsolete-data-sheets library. The change log and any earlier revisions (Rev. 0/A) were not found in search.

counterfeit_notes: No documented AD846 counterfeit cases were found. The part has long been obsolete, though, so any 'new' AN/BN/AQ/BQ stock from marketplace sellers should be treated as suspect (possibly remarked AD844/AD811 or pulls). To check a part, compare its quiescent current (6.5 mA max) and verify it behaves as a current-feedback amp: bandwidth should depend on the feedback-resistor value.
alternatives: AD811 (ADI current-feedback; ADI replacement suggestion according to a diyAudio post; runs warm at ~16 mA Iq)
AD8001 (ADI current-feedback; ADI replacement suggestion according to a diyAudio post)
AD844 (ADI current-feedback, popular for DAC I/V)
NE5534 (named with the AD846 in the AD1862 datasheet for I/V; voltage-feedback)
open_questions: Rev. B print date and change log. Did Rev. 0/A datasheets exist, and do any mirrors freeze them?
Exact obsolescence date and discontinuance PCN number.
Were any other packages or grades made beyond N-8/Q-8 (e.g. LCC or chip)?
Offset drift, input bias current and specified operating supply range were not confirmed via search.
A SPICE macro-model Rev. A (1/91) reportedly covers 'AD846 and AD846A'. What 'AD846A' denotes is unconfirmed.
No silicon or die change was found. The AD846 appears to be a single-die, sole-source part.

corrections: The channel count was 0 for every part number. It is now 1, since the AD846 is a single op amp.
Part-number status was 'unknown'. It is now 'obsolete', based on the ADI product page under /en/products/obsolete/ and the obsolete-data-sheets library.
Added the missing ordering codes AD846BN, AD846AQ, AD846SQ and AD846SQ/883B, with grades and packages from the ADI datasheet ordering guide.
Removed 'stable in open loop' from the technology field. It comes only from a forum post and was not confirmed in the datasheet.

claims_confirmed: The ADI datasheet 'AD846 450 V/us, Precision, Current-Feedback Op Amp' is hosted in the obsolete-data-sheets library, and its text shows 'REV. B': https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/obsolete-data-sheets/270284AD846.pdf
The AD846 product page sits under ADI's obsolete products path: http://www.analog.com/en/products/obsolete/ad846.html

Ordering codes AD846AN/BN (N-8 plastic DIP) and AD846AQ/BQ (Q-8 cerdip), all -40 to +85 C, plus AD846SQ and AD846SQ/883B, -55 to +125 C: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/obsolete-data-sheets/270284AD846.pdf
Datasheet specs: 450 V/us slew, 80 MHz BW at AV=-1, 110 ns settling to 0.01% (10 V step): https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/obsolete-data-sheets/270284ad846.pdf

Datasheet specs: 2 nV/rtHz voltage noise, 20/6 pA/rtHz current noise, 75 uV max Vos (B grade), 6.5 mA max supply current: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/obsolete-data-sheets/270284AD846.pdf
200 MOhm transresistance into 500 Ohm, and 'true 12-bit' (0.01%) precision claim: https://studylib.net/doc/18488908/450-v--s--precision--current-feedback-op-amp-ad846
The AD1862 datasheet recommends the NE5534 or AD846 for I/V conversion: https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/best-opamp-for-i-v-conversion-dac.34324/page-3
The AD846 is discontinued. According to a diyAudio post, ADI suggests the AD8001 or AD811 as replacements: https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/ad-846-replacement.118303/
The diyAudio thread 'AD 846 AN is ther a better sounding opamp out there' exists: https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/ad-846-an-is-ther-a-better-sounding-opamp-out-there.5807/
